Cooking Instructions
Defrost fully before use
Shallow fry for 2-3 minutes till they turn golden brown
Drain well & serve hot with tomato ketchup or a spicy dip
Grill or BBQ: Preheat grill to 180°C. Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally for even cooking
Air-Fry: Preheat air fryer to 200°C. Air-fry kebabs for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through
Oven Bake: Preheat oven to 220°C. Place kebabs on a baking tray and bake for 12-15 minutes, turning once
Pan-Fry: Heat a little oil in a pan and cook for 6-8 minutes, turning occasionally until golden brown

Do not refreeze once thawed

details.usageInstructions:
Cooking Instructions
Deep Fry - (For The Ultimate Crunch!)
Heat oil to 175°C (350°F). Fry frozen fries in small batches
for 3-4 minutes until golden brown. Drain excess oil and transfer to a bowl.
Air Fry - (Less Oil, Still Crispy!)
Preheat air fryer to 200°C (400°F). Spread frozen fries in a
single layer in the air fryer basket. Air fry for 12-15 minutes, shaking
halfway for even crispiness.
Bake - (Guilt-Free & Delicious!) Preheat oven to 220°C
(425°F), Spread frozen fries on a baking tray in a single layer. Bake for
18-20 minutes, flipping halfway for even cooking.
Instructions For Using Seasoning: Evenly sprinkle the Peri
Peri seasoning over the fries, then toss them well to ensure they are fully
coated.
